<subject>Re: Marlin Bay rail upgrade agreement</subject>
<body>
Jon, 

It is expected that by the time the equipment costs referenced in #2 are incurred, the project will be under Tasman Logistics (or its successor/take out entity) since track installation will be nearly complete. Costs incurred in #3 should be Stage 2 Tasman Logistics costs, as this will still be within the installation phase, though possibly just before it begins.

Whitney, I left Amy off this email since she is on site inspection, and reviewed this agreement before she left.

Adam

</body>
